Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim a() As Long, v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ReDim a(1 To 0)
    Case 1
        ReDim a(0 To -1)
    Case 2
        ReDim a(5 To 3)
    Case 3
        ReDim a(1 To 1)
    Case 4
        ReDim a(-1)
    Case 5
        ReDim a(1 To 2, 1 To 0)
    Case 6
        ReDim a(1 To 0, 1 To 2)
    Case 7
        ReDim a(1 To 2): ReDim Preserve a(1 To 0)
    Case 8
        ReDim v(1 To 0)
    Case 9
        ReDim a(0)
    End Select
    Tried = "ok"
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    For i = 0 To 9
        s = s & "|" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
